# Ricardo Meza

> Ricardo Meza is an AI Product Engineer and Product Lead based in Mexico City, on the Labs Team at Clara — Latin America's leading corporate payments platform. He uses AI to solve problems, improve user experiences and automate workflows, and has many years of experience across frontend architecture, full-stack development and team leadership.

At Clara he designs and ships full-stack AI tools from 0 to 1, working across React/Next.js on the frontend and Python/Node.js + OpenShift microservices on the backend.

Before specializing in AI product development he was Frontend Architect at Conekta and Senior Engineer at Rappi and MetaMap, and spent 4 years with Mozilla Foundation and Mozilla México — as Main Manager for Mozilla México he led the localization of Firefox into Mexican Spanish and indigenous languages.

## Work

- Clara — Labs Team (current): full-stack AI tools from 0 to 1 at Latin America's leading corporate payments platform
- Conekta — Frontend Architect
- Rappi — Senior Engineer
- MetaMap — Senior Engineer
- Mozilla Foundation and Mozilla México — Main Manager for Mozilla México, 4 years: localized Firefox into Mexican Spanish and indigenous languages

Full experience: https://www.linkedin.com/in/ricardomeza/

## Apps

- [LightGuard](https://ricardomeza.com/lightguard): protect your sleep from artificial light — it tells you when the place you're in is affecting you
- [ScribuGo](https://scribugo.com/): stories made for you — you answer nine questions, the AI writes it and you read it

## This site

ricardomeza.com is an interactive portfolio with a 3D particle system and a Unix-style terminal emulator. Type `about me`, `apps` or `help` in the terminal to explore.
